{{Quote|You have not won fools! You have simply caused the end of days.|The First Witch of the Wyrd, to the freelance agents who forced the Wyrd to abandon their ritual to corrupt the ch'hala|<ref name="APOD" />}}
The '''First Witch of the Wyrd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] who commanded the [[Wyrd]] witch [[Coven/Legends|coven]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the First Witch directed an unsuccessful attempt to corrupt the [[ch'hala tree]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the process.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Thus we triumph! I invoke the Path of Blood!''"<br />"''I will remember you Mistress!''"<br />"''No. You won't.|The First Witch of the Wyrd and her second-in-command, as the First Witch slew her assistant to call upon the Path of Blood|<ref name="APOD" />}}
The First Witch of the [[Wyrd]] was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tarasin]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who led the Wyrd, a [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the later stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The First Witch had no name, having forsaken her given name as one of her first acts upon joining the Wyrd.<ref name="APOD" />

By around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="19 BBY" /> the Wyrd had suffered various setbacks and the First Witch gathered with the remaining witches at an [[Wyrd encampment|encampment]] in the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of Cularin. As a final gambit to restore the Wyrd's fortunes, the First Witch schemed to use teachings shared with the Wyrd by [[Len Markus]], the leader of the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]], to turn Cularin's [[ch'hala tree]]s  to the dark side. The First Witch believed that this would enable the Wyrd to control the ecology of Cularin and if the witches were unsuccessful at corrupting the ch'hala she planned to simply [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] instead. The witch [[Cheelru]] disagreed with the First Witch's scheme, believing that Wyrd should not risk killing the ch'hala as the damage that would be inflicted to Cularin would leave the coven little to rule over. The First Witch rejected this entreaty and had Cheelru imprisoned as punishment.<ref name="APOD" />

Accompanied by the surviving members of the Wyrd's [[Inner Circle]] and [[Wyrd elite guard|elite guard]], the First Witch ventured to the ch'hala [[Heart Tree]] and commenced a [[Ritual of the Power of the Dark|ritual]] to corrupt the trees. However, after they had been conducting the rite for eleven [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], the First Witch and her companions fell under [[First skirmish at the Heart Tree|attack]] from a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]], forcing them to abandon the ritual. The First Witch then initiated her backup option and murdered her [[Unidentified Wyrd second-in command|second-in-command]] to invoke the [[Path of Blood]] and destroy the ch'hala. However, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] sacrificed himself and merged his consciousness with the Heart Tree to allow it to fight off the First Witch's assault. The power unleashed by the First Witch then reverberated back onto her, causing her to explode. The surviving Wyrd members were defeated by the freelance agents shortly thereafter, resulting in the end of the Wyrd as an established force on Cularin.<ref name="APOD" />

==Personality and traits==
The First Witch had [[Color/Legends|dark]]-colored scales covered with twisting purple markings.<ref name="APOD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The First Witch of the Wyrd featured in ''[[Heart of Evil: A Plague of Darkness|A Plague of Darkness]]'', a [[2005]] roleplaying adventure by [[Ronald A. Heintz]] that served as the first instalment of the [[Heart of Evil trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign. The [[2001]] [[Wizards.com]] article ''[[Liriana: Dark Force Witch of Cularin]]'' established the Tarasin female [[Liriana]] as leader of the Wyrd;<ref name="Liriana Dark Force Witch">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20010913a_witch&c=swlfc|text=Liriana: Dark Force Witch of Cularin}}</ref> the First Witch's name that she bore prior to joining the Wyrd is not stated in ''A Plague of Darkness''<ref name="APOD" /> and it is unclear whether she is intended to be Liriana or another Tarasin. The short story ''[[Reprieves]]'', published on Wizards.com in 2005 makes reference to the Wyrd [[Force Adept|adept]] [[Kirasha]] receiving a mission from the leader of the Wyrd to investigate a drain in the Force strength of the followers of the Tarasin leader [[Dariana]]. The identity of the Wyrd leader in question is not specified and it unclear whether this individual was either the First Witch or Liriana.<ref name="Reprieves">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050113|text=Reprieves|int=Reprieves}}</ref>
